dedupe_keys.name: delta method downscaling r and aml scripts

description: The CCAFS authors publish seven scripts used to prepare Delta Method downscaled climate scenarios. The separate Figshare deposit is CC BY 4.0 and lists R routines for monthly GCM averages and anomalies plus Arc Macro Language scripts for interpolation, resampling and grid construction. A modeller could inspect or adapt the processing steps when producing scenario inputs for infrastructure climate-impact studies. A caveat is that the code targets the older CMIP5 and ArcInfo Workstation 10 workflow; its Arc Macro Language environment and source baseline data may not be readily available today. The published scripts do not themselves provide the seven-terabyte output archive, which has its own WDCC DOI. The article says bias correction focuses on long-term means and has uncertainty that depends on the original models and interpolation choices. I read the own Figshare metadata, file list and article code statement without downloading or running scripts, testing dependencies or reproducing any grid. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
